changes.rationale: In the TPA-induced mouse ear oedema model, Angelica pubescens essential oil (44.6% osthole) reduced TNF-α, COX-2, IL-6 and RelA/p65 levels in skin by immunohistochemistry. [enrichment-pipeline job job_30ae0b20971c9188, candidate cand_6f840dc5095c8d58]

Agastache foeniculum essential oil and oily fraction lowered NADPH-oxidase activity and raised superoxide dismutase and catalase activity and expression in stimulated J774.A1 macrophages. Endocannabinoid modulation, which this entity's mechanism_summary claims, is not supported by this or any retrieved source. [enrichment-pipeline job job_fab2139893c38957, candidate cand_f6ebb94005f3f991]

The Ashitaba chalcones 4-hydroxyderricin and xanthoangelol promoted AMPK and acetyl-CoA-carboxylase phosphorylation in differentiating 3T3-L1 adipocytes, cut glycerol-3-phosphate acyltransferase-1 and raised carnitine palmitoyltransferase-1. PPAR activation is not claimed: PPAR-γ was down-expressed here. [enrichment-pipeline job job_fccd00a270fa2b44, candidate cand_2084651fc90b62d7]

Eugenol, the predominant constituent of clove oil (Syzygium aromaticum), activated Nrf2/HO-1 signalling, raised SOD and reduced glutathione, and suppressed COX-2, NF-κB, IL-6, TNF-α and IL-1β expression in glyphosate-exposed rat liver. [enrichment-pipeline job job_dd7cbb82ab77c9c6, candidate cand_c9aab16d00028f2c]

1,8-Cineol (eucalyptol), the principal constituent of eucalyptus oil, reduced NF-κB p65 nuclear translocation and NF-κB-dependent transcription in LPS-stimulated human cell lines and in peripheral blood mononuclear cells, acting through IκB-α in an IKK-independent way. [enrichment-pipeline job job_1db59ace6705ac07, candidate cand_d844db9fa9d39571]

changes.new_value: Nitric oxide modulation; Vascular function support
changes.rationale: Eucommia ulmoides leaf aqueous extract and its iridoid aucubin restored nitric oxide levels, cut superoxide production and recovered phospho-eNOS Thr495 in ox-LDL-exposed HUVECs — that is, reversed eNOS uncoupling. [enrichment-pipeline job job_5782ef4d4862dbb2, candidate cand_4873edaa6de6a00c]

Galangin, the flavonoid galangal is named for, lowered TNF-α, IL-1β and IL-6 in LPS-stimulated rat bone-marrow mesenchymal stem cells through down-regulation of NF-κB phosphorylation. [enrichment-pipeline job job_d1e3bad4e93ade5b, candidate cand_f137735725da6dfa]

Hippocampal microdialysis in rats: gastrodin, from the rhizome of Gastrodia elata, blunted the ischaemia-induced rise in extracellular glutamate and increased extracellular GABA during reperfusion, lowering the glutamate/GABA ratio. [enrichment-pipeline job job_220df04c66c61dfc, candidate cand_1a0fbf94a91d24e1]

Hops extract and its prenylflavanones 8-PN and 6-PN showed estrogenic activity and activated ERα signalling in human endometrial cells. Stress Response Modulation, the entity's current mechanism_summary, is not what this source shows. [enrichment-pipeline job job_7ba446d1824ec64c, candidate cand_ae16cf8dd5a76a12]

changes.new_value: NF-kB inhibition; Mast-cell stabilization; Cytokine modulation
changes.rationale: H. cordata water extract blocked antigen-induced degranulation (β-hexosaminidase, histamine) in IgE-sensitised RBL-2H3 mast cells, inhibited NF-κB activation and IκB-α degradation, and suppressed IL-4 and TNF-α, with in vivo confirmation in passive cutaneous anaphylaxis. [enrichment-pipeline job job_d13d3486b5ca1db7, candidate cand_433f25e65c5f2e18]

HPLC-based activity profiling of lipophilic Isatis tinctoria leaf extracts localised 5-lipoxygenase inhibition to two fractions — one coinciding with tryptanthrin, the major one with α-linolenic acid. [enrichment-pipeline job job_9e7b533a2cb931fe, candidate cand_867728a9ffb2cbf6]

A dual-luciferase NF-κB reporter screen identified notoginsenoside R1, a saponin specific to Panax notoginseng, as one of four pivotal anti-inflammatory ingredients, with PI3K as its docked target. Confidence is low because the in vivo work is on the three-herb CDDP formula rather than on notoginseng alone. [enrichment-pipeline job job_dc17f18879bed983, candidate cand_dd5333e0a21c82fb]

changes.new_value: NF-kB inhibition; Nrf2 activation; Cytokine modulation
changes.rationale: β-Lapachone, the naphthoquinone from the lapacho tree (Tabebuia / Handroanthus), inhibited NF-κB/AP-1 signalling and proinflammatory cytokine expression in LPS-stimulated microglia and raised HO-1 and NQO1 through the Nrf2/ARE pathway. [enrichment-pipeline job job_0e9e67c3fee7e6ff, candidate cand_9318dc421e3e5e19]

The antidepressant-like effect of Radix Polygalae in mice was blocked by the AMPA antagonist NBQX and accompanied by decreased hippocampal GluR1 ser845 phosphorylation, a ketamine-like glutamatergic signature. BDNF induction is cited from prior work rather than measured here, so it is not claimed. [enrichment-pipeline job job_0d62ce024033a255, candidate cand_cbb3e81b6b8d73d0]

changes.new_value: NF-kB inhibition; Nrf2 activation; COX inhibition
changes.rationale: Poricoic acid GM from the epidermis of Wolfiporia cocos suppressed IκB-α phosphorylation and NF-κB nuclear entry, blocked Keap1–Nrf2 dissociation to drive Nrf2 into the nucleus, and inhibited iNOS and COX-2 protein expression in LPS-induced RAW264.7 macrophages. [enrichment-pipeline job job_20ab1ff71bf12c85, candidate cand_082e237a1fd7d358]

changes.new_value: Estrogen receptor modulation; Lipid metabolism support
changes.rationale: Randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial in 19 postmenopausal women showed HDL and apoA-1 rises and LDL and apoB falls; paired reporter-gene assays showed miroestrol and coumestrol enhance both ERα- and ERβ-mediated transactivation. [enrichment-pipeline job job_a09e0c8cc821c62f, candidate cand_75f6031818c60027]

Nine rotenoids isolated from Boerhaavia diffusa roots were assayed for COX-1 and COX-2 inhibition; boeravinone B was additionally anti-inflammatory in the carrageenan-induced rat paw model. [enrichment-pipeline job job_ac63c5150dba078d, candidate cand_c1fe9281774eaac1]
